update_tag.name: update_tag

parameters.description: The tag (group): pick one, or type its name or UUID.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: Its new name. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: New watches whose URL matches get this tag. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: url_match_pattern

parameters.description: Mute (on) or unmute (off) its watches' notifications. Leave unset to keep it.
parameters.name: muted

muted.description: Whether notifications for its watches are muted

url_match_pattern.description: New watches whose URL matches this pattern get the tag; empty if none

update_watch.description: Change a watch's URL, title, tags, how often it's checked, its filters or which changes count. Settings left empty are kept.
update_watch.name: update_watch

parameters.description: The watch: pick one, or use its UUID (from an earlier step), its exact URL or its title.
parameters.name: watch

parameters.description: The page to watch, such as https://example.com/pricing. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: A name to list it by. Leave empty to keep what it has.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Tags (groups) to file it under, by name, such as Competitors. Ones that don't exist are made. The watch's tags become these. Leave empty to keep what it has.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: How often to check the page, in minutes, such as 60 for hourly or 1440 for daily. Leave empty to keep it; 0 uses the default from changedetection.io's Settings.
parameters.name: check_every_minutes

parameters.description: CSS selectors or XPath, one per line, such as #pricing or //table[1]: only that part of the page is compared. Leave empty to keep what it has.
parameters.name: css_filter

parameters.description: CSS selectors or XPath, one per line, of parts to leave out, such as a footer or an ad (.ads). Leave empty to keep what it has.
parameters.name: remove_elements

parameters.description: Text whose changes don't count, one per line, such as a visitor counter's label. A /regex/ works too. Leave empty to keep what it has.
parameters.name: ignore_text

parameters.description: Text that must be on the page for a change to count, one per line, such as In stock. A /regex/ works too. Leave empty to keep what it has.
parameters.display_name: Only when this text is there
parameters.name: trigger_text

parameters.description: Whether lines added to the page count as a change. On unless you turn it off.
parameters.name: notice_added

parameters.description: Whether lines removed from the page count as a change. Turn this off to hear only when text is added.
parameters.name: notice_removed

parameters.description: Whether lines that changed count as a change. On unless you turn it off.
parameters.name: notice_replaced

parameters.description: Count a change only when a line appears that the page has never had before, such as a new item in a list.
parameters.name: unique_lines_only

parameters.description: Page text changes, or a product page's stock and price (Restock and price), which the restock and price triggers follow. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: watch_type

check_every_minutes.description: How often it's checked, in minutes; 0 when it uses the default from Settings

checks.description: How many times it has been checked

css_filter.description: The CSS or XPath selectors it watches only the part of

currency.description: For a restock watch, the price's currency, such as USD

edit_link.description: A link to the watch's settings in changedetection.io

error.description: Why its last check failed; empty if it worked

history_link.description: A link to the watch's history of changes

in_stock.description: For a restock watch, whether the product is in stock; else null

last_changed.description: When the page last changed (ISO 8601); empty if it hasn't since it was added

last_checked.description: When it was last checked (ISO 8601); empty if never

link.description: The address to open in a browser

name.description: What changedetection.io calls it: its title, else the page's own title, else its URL

notice_added.description: Whether added lines count as a change

notice_removed.description: Whether removed lines count as a change

notice_replaced.description: Whether changed lines count as a change

page_title.description: The page's own title, from its last check

paused.description: Whether it's paused, so it isn't checked

previous_price.description: For a restock watch, the price before its last price change

price.description: For a restock watch, the price found; else null

remove_elements.description: The CSS or XPath selectors of parts it leaves out

snapshots.description: How many snapshots of the page it has kept

title.description: The title given to the watch; empty if none

trigger_text.description: Text that must be on the page for a change to count

unique_lines_only.description: Whether only lines never seen on the page before count as a change

viewed.description: Whether its last change has been looked at in changedetection.io

watch_type.description: What it watches for: text (the page's text) or restock (a product's stock and price)

description: Watch web pages for changes with changedetection.io: add, change, pause and recheck watches, read what changed on a page or across many in a period, organize them with tags, and start a workflow when a page changes, a product is back in stock or its price changes, or a watch starts failing.

changedetection_io_back_in_stock_trigger.description: Runs when a product watched for its stock and price (a Restock and price watch) is found in stock again, with its price. A new watch that finds the product in stock starts it too.

parameters.description: Only watches with this tag (group), by name. Leave blank for every watch.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: Only this watch, by its UUID, its exact URL or its title. Leave blank for every watch (of the tag, if one is given).
parameters.name: watch

changedetection_io_page_changed_trigger.description: Runs when changedetection.io finds a watched page changed, with the changed lines, the lines added and removed, and the page's text now. Of every watch, a tag's, or one.

parameters.description: Only watches with this tag (group), by name. Leave blank for every watch.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: Only this watch, by its UUID, its exact URL or its title. Leave blank for every watch (of the tag, if one is given).
parameters.name: watch

changedetection_io_price_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a product watched for its stock and price (a Restock and price watch) changes price, with the new price and the one before.

parameters.description: Only watches with this tag (group), by name. Leave blank for every watch.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: Only this watch, by its UUID, its exact URL or its title. Leave blank for every watch (of the tag, if one is given).
parameters.name: watch

parameters.description: Only price drops (down) or only rises (up). Leave blank for any price change.
parameters.name: direction

changedetection_io_watch_failing_trigger.description: Runs when a watch's check starts failing, such as the page answering 404 or the filter no longer matching anything, with the error. A watch that recovers and fails again starts it again.

parameters.description: Only watches with this tag (group), by name. Leave blank for every watch.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: Only this watch, by its UUID, its exact URL or its title. Leave blank for every watch (of the tag, if one is given).
parameters.name: watch
